data.ruling: The stock verifier's refutation holds. INA228AIDGSR fails sourcing rule 4. JLCPCB's exact LCSC match C2887910 has stockCount 0 and canPresaleNumber -236. The gate is S4's max(5 x 10, 50) = 50 for a need of 5 boards (S7) x 2 placements (IOBoard.md, one INA228 for each shunt path). A negative presale count fails whatever the stock or need is. The part is not in the 2026-09-25 personal-library export, so rule 6 does not apply. Digi-Key also has 0 in all three packagings, with a 20-week lead time, so rule 5's second-vendor route fails too. Because of the negative presale count and zero stock at both vendors, the part fails the stock gate for any quantity, so the scope is the part. The lifecycle checks pass and are not part of the refutation: TI ACTIVE, Digi-Key Active, EndOfLife false. The datasheet verifier's confirmation is not disputed. The owner fixes the part (Research.md Fixed inputs, IOBoard.md Motor current and voltage monitor, 2026-09-30: no further research, the owner states it returns to stock soon). Under Fixed inputs, a fixed input that fails a check is reported to the owner, not re-selected. So this ruling is reported to the owner and sends no replacement candidate to new verifiers.
